title: 海底火山喷发中破火山口塌陷逾 1 公里，灾害被显著放大
originalTitle: Sudden collapse of submarine volcano drives extreme hazards
bodyText: Seafloor mapping before and after the catastrophic 2022 Hunga eruption showed that the centre of the volcano collapsed by over 1 km, displacing 8.9 ± 0.1 km3 of material. Geophysical surveys show that the caldera collapse occurred during the climactic eruption, triggering extreme tsunami hazards, a stratospheric eruption plume and the breakage of underwater cables.

title: 气候变暖正在削弱亚洲季风对地中海夏季的影响
originalTitle: Reduced Asian monsoon influence on Mediterranean summers in a warmer climate
bodyText: A warming climate may weaken the influence of the South Asian monsoon on Mediterranean summers, as shifting heat and wind patterns reduce its impact on regional weather, according to climate model projections under a high-emissions scenario.

title: 变暖北极的气溶胶—云反馈并不一致，分三种模态
originalTitle: Contrasting aerosol–cloud feedbacks across a warming Arctic
bodyText: Arctic observations over 2003–2024 identify three aerosol regimes with contrasting responses to warming and cloud condensation nuclei trends. Model projections suggest that the aerosol–cloud feedbacks will evolve differently across the Arctic by 2100.

title: 实验模拟"干卵石雨"如何在地球上生成水
originalTitle: Experimental simulation of water formation on Earth from dry pebble rain
bodyText: The growth of planets like Earth through the accretion of pebble-sized material may produce water as pebbles settle through a H2-rich atmosphere and FeO reduces to Fe-rich metal and water, according to experiments of mafic lithologies melted in H2.

title: 人为变暖或把大气河推向人口稠密的亚洲
originalTitle: Anthropogenic warming is projected to divert atmospheric rivers toward densely populated Asia
bodyText: Thermodynamic enhancement of atmospheric rivers (ARs) is projected to dominate subtropical and midlatitude regions, resulting in increased extreme precipitation in Asian urban areas, according to a study integrating a large ensemble of high-resolution global climate models for AR projections.

title: 印度经济繁荣推高用电需求，代价落在城市空气与健康
originalTitle: Economic-boom-driven electricity demand linked to urban air pollution and health in India
bodyText: Rapid economic growth in India since 2000 has increased electricity demand, with most of the electricity generated from coal. This study finds that rising sulfur dioxide emissions and sulfate aerosol pollution increased mortality attributable to PM2.5, whereas cleaner cooking fuels reduced household air pollution.

title: 美国西海岸两条大断裂可能在数小时内接连发震
originalTitle: The “big one” might not come alone: Two major West Coast faults may strike back to back
bodyText: The Cascadia subduction zone and northern San Andreas fault may sometimes rupture in rapid succession, according to evidence preserved in 3,100 years of ocean sediments. Researchers identified unusual sediment layers suggesting that earthquakes on the two systems have occurred just minutes to hours apart, including around the massive Cascadia earthquake of 1700.

title: 亚平宁山脉下正在剥落的地壳，解释拉伸与挤压并存
originalTitle: Peeling crust beneath Italy's Apennines may explain why mountains stretch and squeeze
bodyText: Extending some 1,200 kilometers (750 miles) along the length of Italy, the Apennine Mountains present a challenging puzzle for geologists. In some places, the mountains are steadily being stretched apart, while in regions just tens of kilometers away, they are squeezing together.

title: 降水在增多，一些河流的径流却在减少
originalTitle: 9/17/2026: Rivers losing flow despite receiving more water
bodyText: A new study looking at trends in river flows and precipitation between 1951 and 2020 finds that some rivers levels are falling despite overall increases in rainfall.

title: 让科考船搁浅的楚科奇海海冰本可预报，且会再次发生
originalTitle: 7/30/2026: Ship-stranding Arctic ice was forecastable — and will strike again
bodyText: A NOAA research vessel trapped in sea ice near Alaska. Increasingly mobile sea ice is a growing hazard for the shipping industry as climate change enables boats to use the Chukchi Sea as a new, faster route between Europe, Asia, and North America.

title: 乡村人口收缩与耕地规模化转型协同关系的空间异质性及影响因素——以陕西省为例
originalTitle: 乡村人口收缩与耕地规模化转型协同关系的空间异质性及影响因素——以陕西省为例
bodyText: 基于2010—2020年人口普查、社会经济等数据，本文采用空间分析方法探究陕西省县域乡村人口收缩-耕地规模化转型协同关系的空间异质性，并遵循规模经济与农业生产适宜性理论思想构建解释框架，采用最优参数地理探测器和模糊集定性比较分析（fsQCA）法识别其影响因素及作用路径。研究表明：① 陕西省多数县域在乡村人口收缩背景下实现了耕地规模化转型，2010—2020年全省乡村人口收缩-耕地规模化转型弹性系数（协同性）为10.73%。② 2010—2020年，乡村人口收缩-耕地规模化转型同步区零星分布于各市；耕地规模化转型超前区主要集中于陕北黄土高原区北部、汉中盆地以及西安-商洛交界地带；滞后区呈现轴带格局，主要位于关中平原内部。

title: 科学新闻解读：季风对地中海夏季的影响正在退场
originalTitle: Warming weakens Asian monsoon's reach into the Mediterranean
bodyText: The South Asian summer monsoon has long been known to shape the Mediterranean climate thousands of kilometers away as part of a phenomenon known as the "monsoon–desert" mechanism. Through this mechanism, intense monsoon convection during the summer releases large amounts of heat into the atmosphere, triggering large-scale circulation changes that promote sinking air over the Mediterranean.

title: 尼泊尔末季风强降雨触发 285 处滑坡，15 人遇难
originalTitle: A late monsoon sting in the tail for Nepal
bodyText: Heavy rainfall in Nepal since Thursday has triggered 285 landslides, leading to 15 fatalities with a further three people missing and three people injured. Over the weekend, Nepal (and Sikkim in India) suffered a late monsoon rainfall event that has led to multiple landslides, some of which have to fatalities. The Kathmandu Post has a good article describing these events.
